summary: Reviewed DEV-019 tree 50fa9ed8fe2e727b956a20d6e012d8d6a3baea13. The quota check and increment are a single parameterized statement. Routes reserve before the provider and fail closed on storage errors. Subtask creation uses the server-validated route.

findings.title: Older accessible production deployments can retain the legacy quota policy
findings.detail: If old Vercel generated URLs remain public and share the production database, those deployments may still apply their older quota logic. Check deployment protection before release.

findings.title: Remote integration test clears all counters on its configured target
findings.detail: Run only on a disposable test database. The documented opt-in target must be isolated.

findings.title: Opening an autorun URL can consume a paid production attempt
findings.detail: Reopening a bookmark with autorun can use an attempt. The server still enforces the shared cap.

fallbackReason: Користувач погодив продовження DEV-019 без Claude Code у поточній сесії Codex.
